title: Lava Snare
body:
Syntax: perform lava snare <target>

Description: A Lava Release attack that strikes one target. An off-balance target loses Stamina over time.  Requires Lava Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 203-235. 45% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 14 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
